ACT XXXVI OF 2013
ACT XXXVI OF 2013.
SINDH TENANCY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act to amend the Sindh
Tenancy Act, 1950
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
1st April, 2013]
No.PAS/Legis-B-18/2013,
dated 1-4-2013.---The Sindh Tenancy (Amendment) Bill,
2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 14th March, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 28th March, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Tenancy Act, 1950, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Sindh Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 2013,
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of Sindh Act No.XX of 1950

Governor of Sindh on 28th March, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Tenancy Act, 1950, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment
of Sindh Act No.XX of 1950.---Throughout the Sindh Tenancy Act, 1950,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for the words "Deputy District
Offices. (Revenue)", the words "Assistant Commissioner", for the
words "District Officer (Revenue)", the word "Collector"
and for the words "Executive District Officer (Revenue)", the word
"Commissioner" shall be substituted.

of section 2 of Sindh Act No.XX

(i) in
subsection(1), after the words "pasture", the words "and
includes jagir" shall be omitted;
(II) after subsection
(11), the following shall be inserted:-
"Crop expenditure" means all kind of
amount necessary for maintenance and looking after the water course, Crops, Khuro and Dero;",

of section 17 of Sindh Act No.XX
of 1950.---In the said Act, in section 17, after
the words "picking charges", the words "harvesting, threshing
and other charges including carriage or transport of farm inputs and produce
and expenses shall be calculated at the prevalent market rate and shall be
borne equally by the landlord and the tenant" shall be inserted.

machinery for ploughing, leveling, weeding to enable the crop grown by him to
be efficiently cultivated;".
